channel.description: Latest articles from The Highland Times (thehighlandtimes.com)

item.title: Stone Presses Treasury Over Rural Banking Crisis
item.description: Jamie Stone meets Treasury ministers to press for stronger protections for rural banking services, warning that Highland communities face 100 mile round trips and inadequate support as bank closures continue.The post Stone Presses Treasury Over Rural Banking Crisis appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Short Overnight A9 Closures Planned for Cable Works Near Lynebeg
item.description: Short traffic stoppages will take place on the A9 near Lynebeg on 23 February and 01 March as overhead cables are removed and replaced as part of the Tomatin to Moy dualling project.The post Short Overnight A9 Closures Planned for Cable Works Near Lynebeg appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland Ranger Report Reveals Mounting Visitor Pressures Across Region
item.description: Highland Rangers carried out 1,755 patrols in 2025 as visitor pressures continue across Lochaber, Skye and the NC500, with rising waste and fire risks underlining the ongoing need for responsible access across the region.The post Highland Ranger Report Reveals Mounting Visitor Pressures Across Region appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Allan Duffy Selected as ALBA Highlands and Islands List Candidate
item.description: Former Highland Councillor Allan Duffy has been selected as an ALBA Highlands and Islands List candidate for the May 2026 Scottish Parliament election, outlining priorities on council reform, road investment, education and support for small businesses.The post Allan Duffy Selected as ALBA Highlands and Islands List Candidate appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Leadbitter Demands Answers Over Withheld Orbex Funding
item.description: Graham Leadbitter has demanded answers from the UK Government after Orbex in Forres announced plans to appoint administrators, warning that 160 skilled jobs and Scotland’s role in the space sector are now at risk.The post Leadbitter Demands Answers Over Withheld Orbex Funding appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Council Leader Voices Concern Over Benbecula Bank Closure
item.description: Cllr Paul Steele has raised concerns over the planned closure of the Bank of Scotland branch in Benbecula in July 2026, warning of the impact on older residents, local businesses and staff across Uist and the islands.The post Council Leader Voices Concern Over Benbecula Bank Closure appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Turf Cut on New £21 Million School in Broadford
item.description: Construction has begun on a new £21 million primary school in Broadford on the Isle of Skye, backed by Scottish Government funding, with completion due in summer 2027 and new community facilities planned alongside the campus.The post Turf Cut on New £21 Million School in Broadford appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Secure Scotland Welcomes High Court Ruling on Palestine Action Ban
item.description: Secure Scotland has welcomed a High Court ruling declaring the Palestine Action ban unlawful, as around 40 protesters gathered in Edinburgh and calls were made for the UK Government to reconsider its position.The post Secure Scotland Welcomes High Court Ruling on Palestine Action Ban appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Young Musicians Prepare To Take The Stage in Elgin
item.description: Tickets are now on sale for the Moray Music Centre Spring Concert at Elgin Academy on 14th of March 2026, with around 100 young performers set to take part in a celebration of music across the region.The post Young Musicians Prepare To Take The Stage in Elgin appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A First Step Flat in The Heart of Culloden
item.description: Culloden remains one of Inverness’s most practical and popular areas, and this first floor flat at 43 Alltan Place offers a manageable 37m2 home close to schools, shops and UHI, making it a smart first step or investment choice.The post A First Step Flat in The Heart of Culloden appeared first on The Highland Times.
